description: Hosting integrations can now be authored outside .NET through Aspire's ATS metadata, SDK generation, and runtime dispatch pipeline. A consuming AppHost gets normal generated builder methods while the integration runs in its own runtime and configures the same .NET resource model as a managed integration. TypeScript-authored examples ship today, including Kafka, Deno, and a real `@aspire/nuxt` preview integration.
name: Polyglot hosting integrations through ATS projection
